recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中倍下，陽性細胞不形成明顯結節而是廣泛散佈，其中許多呈中空的環狀結構（疑為包圍 LP 細胞的 rosettes 或膜染色的大細胞），反映 NLPHL 中較瀰漫的變異型態。
features: Diffusely distributed positive cells without a well-defined nodular arrangement in this field
Numerous ring-shaped positive structures with unstained centers, compatible with rosettes around large cells or membranous staining of large cells
Scattered smaller positive cells with membranous red staining between the rings
Background of numerous negative small lymphocytes
Antibody identity not labeled in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at medium power shows positive cells distributed diffusely across the field without a clear nodular pattern. Many positive structures form rings with unstained centers, which may represent rosettes of positive T cells around large cells or crisp membranous staining of large cells; distinction requires higher magnification. Scattered smaller positive cells lie among a predominantly negative small lymphocyte background. In the context of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, a diffuse distribution suggests a variant (diffuse or T-cell-rich) pattern; correlation with the labeled immunopanel, CD21 for follicular dendritic meshworks, and assessment for progression is required.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a diffuse CD8+ T-cell background that typically lacks PD-1+ rosettes and residual CD21+ meshworks.
LRCHL may show rosettes but its large cells are CD30+/CD15+ and weak for PAX5, which requires dedicated staining to separate.
Reactive paracortex shows a mixed population of immunoblasts with preserved sinuses and follicles, not diffuse ringed large cells effacing the node.
